story.title:
Made by hand.
*Made with heart.*
story.body:
Éclat By Sev was born from a simple belief —
that jewellery should feel like a second skin.
Founded by Sev, each collection is designed and handcrafted in small batches,
with attention to every curve and detail.
story.definition: French for radiance. It's what we want every woman who wears our pieces to feel — seen, luminous, and entirely herself.
